whatProducesQualification: a committed durable observation for the exact (projectId, attemptId, invocationId)
a re-read of canonical Work confirming the Attempt exists under this project
a read of the real DSH Session header confirming the session exists and its SessionId matches
the record's sourceBasis matching the VERIFIER's own trusted basis
the Invocation's observation window being CLOSED
exactly ONE distinct SessionId among the candidates
whatCannotProduceQualification: a stored record whose sourceQualificationDeclared says FIRST_PARTY_DSH_QUALIFIED (the field is never read to reach an outcome)
a record with no matching Work Attempt
a record whose basis does not match the deployment's
an unreadable or contradictory Session source
an open or missing observation window
two or more distinct candidate identities

h1Integration.produced: AttemptSessionAssociation with producerEvidence.source = CANONICAL_ATTEMPT_BINDING, durableBindingRef = the committed event id, verification = VERIFIED, observationState = PRODUCER_OBSERVED
h1Integration.fabricatedFields: none — every field is taken from an actual stored fact or an actual read
h1Integration.note: the association is produced but NOT admitted into ordinary Attempt Preview (that is P2-C)

refusalCasesCovered: SOURCE_REFUSED (basis mismatch, foreign Work attempt, header contradiction)
